findings.title: Lightness value swapped: 30% became 70% for $primary
findings.body: The original rule `color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)` was changed to `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%))`. The light-theme branch ($primary) now uses 70% lightness instead of the original 30%, so the light-theme color of `.topic-meta-data h5 a` (embedded post metadata author link) becomes noticeably lighter than intended. The fix is to swap the lightness arguments: `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`.

findings.title: Lightness value changed: 20% became 50% for $primary
findings.body: The original rule `color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%)` for `.topic-map h3` was changed to `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))`. The $primary lightness went from 20% to 50%, so the light-theme topic-map heading (an element with intentionally darker text against a light background) becomes much lighter than before, hurting contrast. The intent of the PR was to add a dark-theme branch, not to alter the light-theme color.

findings.title: Lightness value changed: 30% became 50% for $primary
findings.body: Inside `.user-main .user-stream .group-member-info .name`, the original `color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)` was replaced with `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))`. The light-theme branch now uses 50% lightness instead of 30%, lightening the group-member name text in the light theme. The $primary lightness should be preserved (30%) and only the dark-theme branch ($secondary) should be added.

findings.title: Lightness value swapped: 70% became 30% for $primary
findings.body: The original rule `color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%)` for `.custom-message-length` was replaced with `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`. In the light theme, the text now uses 30% lightness instead of 70%, dramatically darkening it (inverse of the original intent). The arguments are swapped: it should be `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%))`.

findings.title: Lightness value changed: 30% became 50% for $primary
findings.body: Inside `.user-main .user-stream .group-member-info .name` (mobile), the original `color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)` was replaced with `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))`. The light-theme branch now uses 50% lightness instead of 30%, lightening the group-member name text in the mobile user stream. The original $primary lightness (30%) should be preserved and only the $secondary branch added (50%).
